mapper.insert: insert into dws_daily_package_payment(dates, pkg, country, `version`, user_num, pay_amount, exchange_rate, change_amount) select pay_t.dates, c.pkg, 'IN' country, pay_t.version, pay_t.user_num, pay_t.pay_amount, #{singleFee} exchange_rate, ROUND(pay_t.pay_amount / #{singleFee}, 8) change_amount from (select t.dates, SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.campaign_name, '_', 1) channel, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.campaign_name, '_', 2), '_', -1) version, sum(d0_recharge_count) user_num, sum(d0_recharge) pay_amount from ods_pay_record t where t.dates = #{dates} and d0_recharge > 0 and campaign_name is not null GROUP BY t.dates, SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.campaign_name, '_', 1), SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.campaign_name, '_', 2), '_', -1)) pay_t LEFT JOIN dim_channel c on (c.channel_id = pay_t.channel)
